title: orchestrated-rewind-adjudicator-with-synthetic-smoke
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a Rewind Adjudicator that coordinates staged shadow rehearsals and automatic rollback suggestions based on synthetic smoke results and user-configured fidelity gates. No breaking API changes.
commits: a1f4d9d: scaffold adjudicator interface and wire into orchestrator
b2c3e7f: implement synthetic smoke runner with timeout/backoff and deterministic replay seed
c3d4f88: add telemetry anchors and metric extraction helpers
d4e555a: introduce rdctl subcommand and CLI docs for adjudicator
e5f666b: web console panel to visualize adjudicator decisions and replay traces

description: Motivation: Rollouts that rely solely on passive telemetry and long-running A/B experiments often detect regressions too late for low-latency LLM inference workloads. This change introduces the Rewind Adjudicator, an operator-side component that orchestrates short-lived staged shadow rehearsals using a synthetic smoke runner to accelerate regression signal and provide an actionable rollback suggestion. Design summary: The adjudicator is a stateful controller that can be enabled per rollout via helm values or the rollout spec. It coordinates three phases: 1) Dry rehearsal where a bounded subset of traffic is shadowed and replayed deterministically against a candidate revision; 2) Synthetic smoke where generated prompts (user-provided or default prompt bank) exercise known SLO-sensitive slices and produce a compact metrics digest; 3) Decision adjudication where telemetry anchors (latency P95, token-cost delta, accuracy proxy via eval hooks) are compared against configured fidelity gates and historical baselines to compute a risk score and suggested action. Key behaviors: - Non-blocking: when the adjudicator is experimental it only attaches suggestions to the rollout decision; when promoted it can block promotion until gates pass. - Deterministic replay seeding ensures reproducible smoke runs for postmortem. - Graceful fallback: if the adjudicator or replay runner fails the orchestrator continues with existing staged rollout policy and records the failure as an event for triage. API and surface changes: - rollout.spec.adjudicator.{enabled,mode,probeSet} new fields to opt-in and configure synthetic smoke parameters. - rdctl adjudicator subcommand: rdctl rollout adjudicator status|replay|force-rollback. - Console panel to visualize adjudicator decisions and replay traces. Testing and rollout plan: Unit coverage for the decision logic and telemetry extraction. E2E suite triggers a short staged shadow rehearsal and asserts the adjudicator suggests rollback under injected regression signals. Feature gated behind helm.values.rollouts.adjudicator.enabled=false by default. Observability: added Prometheus rules and tracing annotations for adjudicator-run.{start,success,fail} and a compact decision event schema emitted to the event bus for easier SLO backfills. Security and compliance: replayed inputs are masked by default using existing PII redaction hooks; customers can opt into raw replays via Private deployments and KMS-wrapped storage. Backwards compatibility: no changes to the public runtime API. Migration: operators can enable the adjudicator per-rollout incrementally and tune probe sets with the new rdctl CLI. Impact: expected to reduce mean time to detect latent regressions in canary/promote flows by surfacing actionable signals within minutes rather than hours. Related work: builds on ENG-7201 (staged-shadow plumbing) and complements ENG-7920 (telemetry anchors). Linear: ENG-8421 and ENG-8479. CI matrix: flaky test adjusted and stabilized in e2e harness. Merge notes: squad validated on dedicated staging cluster for three days with controlled traffic and synthetic regressions applied.
review_comments: Jordan Kim (reviewer): This is a significant addition to the rollout surface. Please ensure the decision algorithm is explainable and add logging that records the contributing metrics for a suggestion.

Asha Patel (author): Added a decisionTrace payload that records the metric deltas and gate thresholds used; see pkg/orchestrator/adjudicator.go line 210. We also emit the compact decision event to the event bus for postmortem queries.
Priya Shah (reviewer): The default probe bank might leak personal data if customers supply arbitrary prompts. Can we ensure redaction is applied to both replay and synthetic buckets by default?
Asha Patel (author): Default behavior now applies redactPipeline to all replay inputs. Added docs in cmd/rdctl/rollback_adjudicator.md and a helm toggle to opt into raw replays for Private installs.
Mateo Rivera (reviewer): CI e2e was flaky once. Can we add retry logic to the synthetic smoke runner and make the harness deterministic?
Asha Patel (author): Added exponential backoff with bounded retries and deterministic seeding; updated tests to use replay fixture with timeouts tightened. CI flakiness resolved.
Jordan Kim (approver): Code review complete. Approving after docs updates.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature via helm: rollouts.adjudicator.enabled=true and supply optional probe set via rollouts.adjudicator.probeSet. Start with mode=observe to gather decision traces before enforcing gate blocks. Monitor adjudicator_run_success_rate and decision_risk_score. If adjudicator causes unexpected blocking, disable by setting rollouts.adjudicator.enabled=false and trigger rdctl rollout adjudicator force-rollback to revert suggestions.
